title: AI Workflow Leverage: measure the work before claiming the gain
audience: Teams comparing human and AI-assisted maintenance work who need the same task, oracle, and evidence contract on both sides.
promise: Pair one real Tenure maintenance task with a shared quality oracle, then show exactly which measurements are still unknown before making an efficiency claim.
story: One attributable Tenure task is fixed against a protected baseline, with an allowlisted file scope and explicit exclusions.
Manual and assisted lanes receive identical inputs, completion criteria, and behavioral checks.
The shared oracle checks observable state, focused tests, scope, and provenance without treating the historical reference implementation as a measured lane.
The story stops at the missing append-only event contract instead of inventing time, retries, human touches, failures, or quality deltas.
verified_locally: AL-1 selects the real Tenure task Expose Tenure review and capture task-state contracts.
Both lanes share a protected baseline, allowlisted paths, exclusions, and one quality oracle.
The synthetic appendix has one valid contract and two fail-closed mutations.
The AL-2 receipt identifies agent-eval-runtime as the owner of the missing paired-measurement event contract.
The local 1600x900 preview keeps the paired-lane concept and blocker visible without exposing private source data.
open_gates: Approve and implement the shared append-only event schema in agent-eval-runtime.
Run the manual and bounded assisted lanes prospectively with raw receipts.
Apply the same quality oracle and reconcile any supported deltas.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a real comparable task, a fixed paired protocol, a shared quality oracle, and a reason-coded measurement blocker. It does not claim that AI is faster, that quality held in a paired run, that the historical reference implementation is an outcome, or that the case is hosted or published.
